hazards.control: Instrument power isolated before sensor changes; cables routed off the ground.

tabs.overview: The treating plot is the same picture as the simulator chart: surface pressure, slurry rate, and proppant concentration, with the kickout line. The treater watches the pressure trend for a screenout or a break, adjusts rate and sand, and calls the shutdown. Company representatives watch the same plot from a second seat.
tabs.engineering: One-second data; job logs per stage; redundant transducers averaged.
tabs.safety: The van sits outside the red zone; radios to the pumps and the wireline unit.
tabs.evidence: Field practice at the frac van and wellsite instrumentation (S9); pressure transducer practice (S31 missile patent for header instruments); no vendor data.

name: Frac van (data van) and the treating plot
function: The control trailer where the treater runs the job: the treating plot of pressure, rate, and density against time, the pump controls, and the chemical setpoints.
